verbs.description: One paper in full, for `search get` on the `kb` and `library` sources: its title, authors, date, journal, url, and its abstract and body as one text.

Papers one hop from the given papers: their authors' other papers (`authors`), the papers they cite (`cites`) or the papers citing them (`cited_by`), ranked by personalized PageRank from the first five, the first weighted most, and never by meaning; ties go to the newest.

verbs.description: The tail of the kb server's log. Operator only.

Papers for the archive's live `kb` source, in search's sections: `exact` holds papers whose title, abstract or body holds the query literally, then papers matching its words. `related` holds papers near the query in meaning (the entry index's best papers per zone, merged with the keyword matches). A hit carries its id, title, date and url and no passages; `kb get` reads the paper. The answer says in `degraded` what it could not use, for example the encoder or the index. `search query` calls it; call that instead.
